name: CyberStockroom
description_en:
CyberStockroom organizes inventory around a visual map of locations and sublocations. Users can inspect the contents of a room, vehicle or bin, move stock between locations and see where a product is distributed.

The map is the product’s central operating model. It is most useful to evaluate where items are and how they move, rather than assuming it supplies every purchasing, accounting or manufacturing function associated with broader inventory suites.
description_zh:
CyberStockroom 以地点和子地点的可视化地图组织库存。用户可查看房间、车辆或料箱内的物品，在地点间移动库存，并查看某种商品的分布。

地图是其核心作业模型。评估重点应是物品在哪里、如何流动，不能预设它提供广义库存套件的所有采购、会计或制造功能。

core_features.explanation_en: Locations can represent warehouses, buildings, floors, stores, vehicles and bins.
core_features.explanation_zh: 地点可表示仓库、建筑、楼层、门店、车辆和料箱。

core_features.explanation_en: The homepage describes drag-and-drop transfers, counts and viewing a product across locations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 主页说明拖放转移、盘点及跨地点查看商品。

sections.title_en: Map a stockroom and two service vehicles
sections.title_zh: 绘制库房及两辆服务车
sections.en: Define and clearly label the physical locations before adding products. The setup guide describes opening the Map dashboard, creating locations and arranging the layout, then creating products or importing a spreadsheet. A useful pilot moves spare parts from the stockroom to a vehicle, checks them out for a job and reconciles the remaining quantities.
sections.zh: 添加商品前先定义并清楚标记实物地点。设置指南说明进入 Map 面板、创建地点、排列布局，再创建商品或导入表格。可用备件从库房转入车辆、现场领出并核对余量的流程试点。

sections.title_en: Make location and product records consistent
sections.en: Products can have images, barcodes and custom fields. The guide describes both individual creation and bulk uploads. Establish consistent identifiers and units before loading a full spreadsheet, and check whether a moved item retains the required metadata. A visual map helps locate recorded stock; it cannot repair inaccurate opening counts by itself.
sections.zh: 商品可有图片、条码和自定义字段，指南同时说明单项创建与批量上传。导入完整表格前应统一标识和单位，并检查转移后是否保留所需资料。地图有助于定位已记录库存，但无法自行修正错误的期初盘点。

sections.title_en: Verify subscription amounts with the vendor
sections.en: The official pricing anchor states that monthly and annual plans are available and offers a discovery call. Numeric plan amounts and capacity limits were not exposed in the text read. A 14-day trial without a credit card is explicitly advertised. That trial does not establish a permanently free plan; a quote should include users, locations, items and any device or integration costs.
sections.zh: 官方价格锚点说明提供月付和年付方案，并邀请预约沟通。已读文字没有显示数值价格与容量上限；明确宣传无需信用卡的 14 天试用。试用不构成长期免费方案，询价应覆盖用户、地点、商品及设备或集成费用。

sections.title_en: Test traceability rather than visual appeal alone
sections.title_zh: 除地图外检查流转追踪
sections.en: Teams managing spare parts, job-site supplies or dispersed storage can use the location model to reduce searching. Evaluate an incorrect transfer, a partial withdrawal and a physical count discrepancy. Purchasing depth, financial valuation, offline work, export completeness and recovery after an interrupted scan remain unverified.
sections.zh: 管理备件、工地物资或分散仓储的团队可用地点模型减少查找。应评估错误转移、部分领用和实物盘点差异。采购深度、财务计价、离线作业、完整导出及扫描中断恢复尚未核实。
